reasoning_content: While waiting for the reproduction (about 90 seconds), let's check the progress of npm install.

action.command: ps aux | grep -c "[n]pm install"; tail -5 /tmp/npm_install.log; echo "==="; ls /workspace/node_modules/.bin/ 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(nx|tsc|prisma)$"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "ps aux | grep -c \"[n]pm install\"; tail -5 /tmp/npm_install.log; echo \"===\"; ls /workspace/node_modules/.bin/ 2>/dev/null | grep -E \"^(nx|tsc|prisma)$\"", "security_risk": "UNKNOWN", "summary": "Check npm install completion"}
